theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners combine every leg the detector's one validated edge cares about: durability_bar 0.66 (high), breadth 0.75 (high cohesion), hurst_tag mixed but eligible, crowding false. Trend-gate eligibility plus broad participation is the most defensible setup in the list — this is where a vol-aware allocation sits most comfortably, not because it ranks #2 but because its risk texture is cleaner than the crowded #1 leader.
evidence: breadth 0.75 — broad participation, not a single-name story
gate_helps true — absolute-trend gate validated for drawdown control
theses.dissent: Silver miners are high-beta and can gap with industrial PM sentiment; if the macro 'geopolitics' narrative (dominant in headlines) flips risk-off, a crowded-out precious metals bid could reverse hard even with good breadth.
